text:
sam: Quick sync on callable API surface — product wants a lightweight, auditable v1 by end of Q2.
mira: Customers repeatedly ask for typed tool schemas + clear async path. Also want visibility into failed calls for support.
jamal: Engineering suggests two-stage approach: v1 = sync responses + schema enforcement; v2 = async webhooks + streaming partials. Keeps rollout low-risk.
kevin: Security: webhooks introduce outbound network and auth concerns. For v1 we should require response signatures for cross-boundary tool execution.
olivia: Telemetry ask: include correlation ids (trace_id), per-call token counts, and an optional confidence/probability field when model produced the tool output. This helps eval linking.
release-bot: scheduled canary: 14 days post-deploy; automated contract tests must pass.
sam: Proposed v1 envelope (sync) — single top-level envelope_version, immutable call_id, and result with typed status codes.
mira: Example shape (inline JSON):
```json
{
  \"envelope_version\": \"1\",
  \"call_id\": \"1679000000\",
  \"tool\": \"summarize\",
  \"input\": \"{...}\",
  \"result\": {
    \"status\": \"ok\",
    \"output\": \"string|object\",
    \"error_code\": null,
    \"meta\": {\"duration_ms\": 80}
  },
  \"telemetry\": {\"trace_id\": \"abc123\", \"tokens\": 40}
}
```
jamal: v1 decisions to lock: JSON Schema for tool manifests, `envelope_version` field, `result.status` uses a closed set (ok, error), and structured `error_code` taxonomy.
kevin: Add `signature` and `content_type` fields; response signatures required if tool runs in a different trust domain.
mira: Roadmap proposal: Q2 GA v1 (sync + manifests + observability), Q3 optional webhooks (v1.1) pending enterprise review, Q4 streaming + chunked envelope (v2).
sam: Launch gates (engineering):
- Public schema + docs
- Server-side validation + contract suite
- SDK migration examples (JS/Python)
- Canary with 2 committed customers
- Telemetry dashboards and alert thresholds
kevin: Compliance gating: webhooks require legal + security signoff; private installs may get pull-based adapters instead of inbound webhooks.
mira: Prioritization rationale: prioritize customers with enterprise commits for webhook work, keep PLG dev experience competitive with a simple sync path.
olivia: Evals integration: ensure trace_id surfaces in logs and retention for x days; include optional confidence and token-level counts for downstream analysis.
jamal: For streaming later: consider newline-delimited JSON with chunk metadata (sequence, final flag) to simplify reassembly. Also consider backpressure signals.
release-bot: preflight test: contract suite failing 2/18 in staging (enum mismatch on status).
jamal: I'll resolve enum mismatch tonight. Likely docs vs impl drift.
mira: SDK migration snippet for docs (JS):
```js
const res = await client.call({tool: 'extract_entities', input: {text}})
if (res.result.status === 'error') {
  // map error_code to retry/alert
}
process(res.result.output)
```
sam: Open questions to decide by Friday: 1) envelope version vs Accept header for versioning, 2) semantics: `tool` vs `action` naming, 3) exact error taxonomy strings.
jamal: My recommendation: explicit envelope_version field (easier for offline logs), keep `tool` but document synonyms, use error classes: `validation`, `execution`, `resource_limit`, `auth`.
kevin: Also require `content_type` for non-JSON payloads and a max payload size.
mira: Action items: jamal -> PR v1 schema by Thu EOD; sam -> draft launch checklist + partner canary list; kevin -> security checklist for signatures/webhooks; olivia -> telemetry key spec and retention.
sam: If legal approves, we try to include webhooks as optional in v1.1 and give customers a migration window.
release-bot: reminder: include changelog entry and upgrade guide for breaking changes.
sam: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene Friday for final sign-off. :raised_hands:
